correctness.rationale: Exact Markov reset-age conditioning yields the stationary two-time covariance identity. The subcritical/supercritical cubic flow solutions were reconstructed and expanded with uniform-in-age error; monotone covariance signs prove strict positive coefficients, with the equilibrium reset case isolated. At criticality the constant order t^{-1/2} cancels upon centering, leaving a t^{-3/2} term; exponential age integrates the Taylor remainder and the incomplete-gamma coefficient follows by substitution. Standalone mpmath checker replayed all 37 independent assertions; computations are supportive, not infinity proofs.

originality.rationale: The same Ott--Antonsen flow and its one-time stationary law are established by Sarkar--Gupta 2022 and Bressloff 2024, and the later Acharya--Sarkar--Gupta 2025 correlation discussion concerns a one-time variance. Against inspected complete primary text and searched claim-level published findings, the present claim is distinct: it supplies the stationary cross-time covariance and a three-regime, positive-coefficient long-lag asymptotic with a nontrivial critical three-halves factor. This is best-knowledge originality, not proof of exhaustive priority; standard regenerative facts constitute a reduction risk.

value.rationale: Time-lagged collective synchrony is a physically motivated observable not determined by the already known resetting stationary density. A new exact critical three-halves memory exponent and strictly positive coefficient exhibit the difference between stationary instantaneous coherence and long-time memory, and distinguish coupling regimes even when resetting makes stationary mean coherence positive. The leading critical t^{-1/2} trajectory disappears only after centering, a nontrivial feature with direct implications for temporal observables. Not a mere normalization or arbitrary parameter slice.
